 CAREER SUMMARY  
Trade Settlement & Clearance professional with 9 years of experience in Investment Banking Operations, specializing in post-trade 
processing, securities settlement, trade lifecycle management, reconciliation, and exception management. Proven expertise in ensuring 
accurate and timely settlement of equity, fixed income, and derivative transactions across global markets. Experienced in collaborating with 
brokers, custodians, counterparties, and front-to-backoffice teams to resolve settlement issues, minimize operational risk, and meet strict 
service-level agreements (SLAs). Strong understanding of capital markets, settlement regulations, operational controls, and process 
improvement initiatives.

 PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE  
Trade Settlement ( 5 Years) 
• Managed the complete trade lifecycle from trade capture through settlement, ensuring timely and accurate processing of securi ties 
transactions. 
• Executed trade matching, confirmation, affirmation, and settlement for equity, fixed income, ETF, mutual fund, and derivative  products 
across domestic and international markets. 
• Monitored settlement obligations and ensured successful settlement within market timelines (T+1/T+2), minimizing settlement f ailures. 
• Investigated and resolved failed trades by coordinating with brokers, custodians, counterparties, and internal operations tea ms. 
• Validated trade details, Standing Settlement Instructions (SSI), settlement instructions, and counterparty information before  settlement. 
• Processed trade amendments, cancellations, cash transfers, security movements, and manual settlement instructions.  
• Performed daily reconciliation of cash balances, securities positions, broker statements, and custodian records, resolving re conciliation 
breaks promptly. 
• Monitored pending settlements and aged fails, conducted root cause analysis, and implemented corrective actions to reduce rec urring 
exceptions. 
• Supported corporate action events, ensuring accurate processing of dividends, stock splits, mergers, rights issues, and bonus  issues. 
• Worked closely with Front Office, Middle Office, Risk, Compliance and custodian  
• Prepared daily operational reports, settlement MIS, fail reports, aged exception reports, and KPI dashboards for management r eview. 
• Ensured compliance with market regulations, internal controls, operational policies, and audit requirements. Contributed to process 
improvement initiatives by identifying automation opportunities and standardizing operational procedures to improve efficienc y and 
reduce manual intervention.  
 
Mutual Fund Accounting (3 years) 
 
• Performed daily Net Asset Value (NAV) calculations for multiple mutual funds in accordance with fund accounting policies 
and client Service Level Agreements (SLAs). 
• Processed income accruals, dividend income, interest income, realized and unrealized gains/losses, and operating expense 
accruals. 
• Performed daily cash, custody, investment, and general ledger reconciliations, investigating and resolving discrepancies befo re 
NAV release. 
• Reviewed corporate actions such as dividends, stock splits, bonus issues, mergers, rights issues, and their impact on fund 
valuation. 
• Supported preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, investor reports, and regulatory reporting 
schedules. 
• Participated in month-end and year-end closing activities, ensuring timely completion of reconciliations and accounting 
adjustments. 
 
HNI Client management (2 years 6 Months) 
 
• Managed day-to-day interactions with HNI clients, addressing accounting and operational queries related to cash balances, 
transactions, and portfolio holdings.  
• Acted as the primary point of contact for resolving client queries on cash and position reconciliations, ensuring timely 
investigation and closure of breaks.  
• Coordinated with internal teams (operations, custody, and treasury) to resolve discrepancies and ensure accuracy of client -level 
financial data. 
• Monitored and validated client transactions, cash movements, and portfolio updates to maintain accurate records and ensure 
smooth operational workflow.
